# Load Data


## Load Models and Adjusted Draws

```{r}
load("objects/models.RData")
aap_m1_ideo  <- readRDS("objects/aap_m1_ideo.rds")
aap_m1_party <- readRDS("objects/aap_m1_party.rds")
aap_m2_ideo  <- readRDS("objects/aap_m2_ideo.rds")
aap_m2_party <- readRDS("objects/aap_m2_party.rds")
aap_m3_ideo  <- readRDS("objects/aap_m3_ideo.rds")
aap_m3_party <- readRDS("objects/aap_m3_party.rds")
```

## Select Variables

```{r}
amp_select <- amp_data|>
  dplyr::select(
    RACETHNICITY,
    IDEO,
    imm_shared = V38D,
    imm_safety = V41SAFETY_4,
    imm_jobs = V41JOBS_4,
    imm_welfare = V41WELFARE_4,
    imm_morals = V41MORALS_4,
    PartyID7,
    PartyID5,
    AGE,
    GENDER,
    EDUC5,
    INCOME9,
    ethnicity_importance = V18IMPETHNICITY,
    ethnicity_proud = V19PROUDETHNICITY,
    race_proud = V14A,
    race_importance = V13IMPRACE,
    ethnicity = V17ETHNICITY,
    limit_imm = V43A,
    english_imm = V43B,
    amnesty_imm = V43C,
    law_imm = V43D,
    V21RELIGPREF,
    V2024ELECTION,
    REGION9,
    CONPROT
  )
```

## Clean variables

```{r}
amp_clean <- amp_select|>
  mutate(
    race = case_when(
      RACETHNICITY == 1 ~ 'White',
      RACETHNICITY == 2 ~ 'Black',
      RACETHNICITY == 3 ~ NA_character_,
      RACETHNICITY == 4 ~ 'Hispanic',
      RACETHNICITY == 5 ~ NA_character_,
      RACETHNICITY == 6 ~ 'AAPI',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    race = fct_relevel(race, "White")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    region = case_when(
      REGION9 == 1 ~ "New England",
      REGION9 == 2 ~ "Mid-Atlantic",
      REGION9 == 3 ~ "East-North Central",
      REGION9 == 4 ~ "West-North Central",
      REGION9 == 5 ~ "South Atlantic",
      REGION9 == 6 ~ "East-South Central",
      REGION9 == 7 ~ "West-South Central",
      REGION9 == 8 ~ "Mountain",
      REGION9 == 9 ~ "Pacific",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(
    ideology = case_when(
      IDEO == -1 ~ NA_character_,
      IDEO == 1 ~ 'Very Liberal',
      IDEO == 2 ~ 'Somewhat Liberal',
      IDEO == 3 ~ 'Moderate',
      IDEO == 4 ~ 'Somewhat Conservative',
      IDEO == 5 ~ 'Very Conservative',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(ideology = fct_relevel(ideology, "Moderate")) |>
  mutate(
    party_id_7 = case_when(
      PartyID7 == -1 ~ NA_character_,
      PartyID7 == 1 ~ "Strong Democrat",
      PartyID7 == 2 ~ "Not so Strong Democrat",
      PartyID7 == 3 ~ "Lean Democrat",
      PartyID7 == 4 ~ "Don't Lean",
      PartyID7 == 5 ~ "Lean Republican",
      PartyID7 == 6 ~ "Not so Strong Republican",
      PartyID7 == 7 ~ "Strong Republican",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(party_id = fct_relevel(party_id_7, "Don't Lean"))|>
  mutate(
    party_id = case_when(
      PartyID5 == -1 ~ NA_character_,
      PartyID5 == 1 ~ "Democrat",
      PartyID5 == 2 ~ "Lean Democrat",
      PartyID5 == 3 ~ "Don't Lean/Independent/None",
      PartyID5 == 4 ~ "Lean Republican",
      PartyID5 == 5 ~ "Republican",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  drop_na(party_id) |>
  mutate(party_id = fct_relevel(party_id, "Don't Lean/Independent/None"))|>
  mutate(
    imm_safety_recode = case_when(
      imm_safety == 0 ~ 'No',
      imm_safety == 1 ~ 'Yes',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(
    imm_shared_recode = case_when(
      imm_shared == 1 ~ 'Almost completely agree',
      imm_shared == 2 ~ 'Somewhat agree',
      imm_shared == 3 ~ 'Somewhat disagree',
      imm_shared == 4 ~ 'Do not agree at all',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(
    imm_jobs_recode = case_when(
      imm_jobs == 0 ~ 'No',
      imm_jobs == 1 ~ 'Yes',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(
    imm_welfare_recode = case_when(
      imm_welfare == 0 ~ 'No',
      imm_welfare == 1 ~ 'Yes',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))|>
  mutate(
    imm_morals_recode = case_when(
      imm_morals == 0 ~ 'No',
      imm_morals == 1 ~ 'Yes',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))|>
  mutate(
    gender = case_when(
      GENDER == 1 ~ "Male",
      GENDER == 2 ~ "Female",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_))|>
  mutate(
    education = case_when(
      EDUC5 == 1 ~ "Less than high school",
      EDUC5 == 2 ~ 'High School Degree',
      EDUC5 == 3 ~ 'Some college/Associates',
      EDUC5 == 4 ~ 'College graduate',
      EDUC5 == 5 ~ 'Post grad study/professional degree',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    education = fct_relevel(education, "College graduate")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    income = case_when(
      INCOME9 == 1 ~ 'Under $10,000',
      INCOME9 == 2 ~ '$10,000 to under $20,000',
      INCOME9 == 3 ~ '$20,000 to under $30,000',
      INCOME9 == 4 ~ '$30,000 to under $40,000',
      INCOME9 == 5 ~ '$40,000 to under $50,000',
      INCOME9 == 6 ~ '$50,000 to under $75,000',
      INCOME9 == 7 ~ '$75,000 to under $100,000',
      INCOME9 == 8 ~ '$100,000 to under $150,000',
      INCOME9 == 9 ~ '$150,000 or more',
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(ethn_imp_recode = case_when(
    ethnicity_importance == 1 ~ 'Very important',
    ethnicity_importance == 2 ~ 'Somewhat important',
    ethnicity_importance == 3 ~ 'Not very important',
    ethnicity_importance == 4 ~ 'Not important at all',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(ethn_proud_recode = case_when(
    ethnicity_proud == 1 ~ 'Strongly agree',
    ethnicity_proud == 2 ~ 'Somewhat agree',
    ethnicity_proud == 3 ~ 'Somewhat disagree',
    ethnicity_proud == 4 ~ 'Strongly disagree',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(race_imp_recode = case_when(
    race_importance == 1 ~ 'Very important',
    race_importance == 2 ~ 'Somewhat important',
    race_importance == 3 ~ 'Not very important',
    race_importance == 4 ~ 'Not important at all',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(limit_imm_reverse = case_when(
    limit_imm == 1 ~ 4,
    limit_imm == 2 ~ 3,
    limit_imm == 3 ~ 2,
    limit_imm == 4 ~ 1,
    limit_imm == 77 ~ NA_real_,
    limit_imm == 98 ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
  mutate(limit_imm_recode = case_when(
    limit_imm_reverse == 1 ~ 'Strongly disagree',
    limit_imm_reverse == 2 ~ 'Somewhat disagree',
    limit_imm_reverse == 3 ~ 'Somewhat agree',
    limit_imm_reverse == 4 ~ 'Strongly agree',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(english_imm_reverse = case_when(
    english_imm == 1 ~ 4,
    english_imm == 2 ~ 3,
    english_imm == 3 ~ 2,
    english_imm == 4 ~ 1,
    english_imm == 77 ~ NA_real_,
    english_imm == 98 ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
  mutate(english_imm_recode = case_when(
    english_imm_reverse == 1 ~ 'Strongly disagree',
    english_imm_reverse == 2 ~ 'Somewhat disagree',
    english_imm_reverse == 3 ~ 'Somewhat agree',
    english_imm_reverse == 4 ~ 'Strongly agree',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(
    amnesty_imm_recode = case_when(
      amnesty_imm == 1 ~ "Strongly agree",
      amnesty_imm == 2 ~ "Somewhat agree",
      amnesty_imm == 3 ~ "Somewhat disagree",
      amnesty_imm == 4 ~ "Strongly disagree",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(law_imm_reverse = case_when(
    law_imm == 1 ~ 4,
    law_imm == 2 ~ 3,
    law_imm == 3 ~ 2,
    law_imm == 4 ~ 1,
    law_imm == 77 ~ NA_real_,
    law_imm == 98 ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_)) |>
  mutate(law_imm_recode = case_when(
    law_imm_reverse == 1 ~ 'Strongly disagree',
    law_imm_reverse == 2 ~ 'Somewhat disagree',
    law_imm_reverse == 3 ~ 'Somewhat agree',
    law_imm_reverse == 4 ~ 'Strongly agree',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(voting = case_when(
    V2024ELECTION == 1 ~ 'Donald Trump',
    V2024ELECTION == 2 ~ 'Kamala Harris',
    V2024ELECTION == 3 ~ 'Someone else',
    V2024ELECTION == 4 ~ 'Do not plan to vote in this race',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(relig_pref_recode = case_when(
    V21RELIGPREF == 1 ~ 'Protestant',
    V21RELIGPREF == 2 ~ 'Catholic',
    V21RELIGPREF == 3 ~ 'Eastern Orthodox',
    V21RELIGPREF == 4 ~ 'Mormon',
    V21RELIGPREF == 5 ~ 'Jewish',
    V21RELIGPREF == 6 ~ 'Muslim',
    V21RELIGPREF == 7 ~ 'Buddhist',
    V21RELIGPREF == 8 ~ 'Hindu',
    V21RELIGPREF == 9 ~ 'Some other religion',
    V21RELIGPREF == 10 ~ 'Spiritual but not religious',
    V21RELIGPREF == 11 ~ 'Atheist',
    V21RELIGPREF == 12 ~ 'Agnostic',
    V21RELIGPREF == 13 ~ 'Nonreligious',
    V21RELIGPREF == 14 ~ 'Nothing in particular',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) |>
  mutate(conprot = case_when(
    CONPROT == 0 ~ 'No',
    CONPROT == 1 ~ 'Yes',
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)
  )
```

### Making ordered variables

```{r}
unique(amp_clean$limit_imm_recode)
amp_clean$limit_imm_recode <- factor(amp_clean$limit_imm_recode,
                                     ordered = TRUE,
                                     levels = c("Strongly disagree", "Somewhat disagree", "Somewhat agree", "Strongly agree"))


unique(amp_clean$english_imm_recode)
amp_clean$english_imm_recode <- factor(amp_clean$english_imm_recode,
                                       ordered = TRUE,
                                       levels = c("Strongly disagree", "Somewhat disagree", "Somewhat agree", "Strongly agree"))


unique(amp_clean$amnesty_imm_recode)
amp_clean$amnesty_imm_recode <- factor(amp_clean$amnesty_imm_recode,
                                       ordered = TRUE,
                                       levels = c("Strongly disagree", "Somewhat disagree", "Somewhat agree", "Strongly agree"))

unique(amp_clean$law_imm_recode)
amp_clean$law_imm_recode <- factor(amp_clean$law_imm_recode,
                                   ordered = TRUE,
                                   levels = c("Strongly disagree", "Somewhat disagree", "Somewhat agree", "Strongly agree"))
```

# Table 1. Demographics

```{r}
amp_table <- amp_clean |>
  select(
    race,
    AGE,
    gender,
    education,
    income,
    region,
    ideology,
    party_id,
    limit_imm_recode,
    english_imm_recode,
    amnesty_imm_recode,
    law_imm_recode
  ) |>
  mutate(
    # Education
    education = factor(education,
                       levels = c("Less than high school",
                                  "High School Degree",
                                  "Some college/Associates",
                                  "College graduate",
                                  "Post grad study/professional degree"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
    
    # Income
    income = factor(income,
                    levels = c("Under $10,000",
                               "$10,000 to under $20,000",
                               "$20,000 to under $30,000",
                               "$30,000 to under $40,000",
                               "$40,000 to under $50,000",
                               "$50,000 to under $75,000",
                               "$75,000 to under $100,000",
                               "$100,000 to under $150,000",
                               "$150,000 or more"),
                    ordered = TRUE),
    
    # Ideology
    ideology = factor(ideology,
                      levels = c("Very Liberal",
                                 "Somewhat Liberal",
                                 "Moderate",
                                 "Somewhat Conservative",
                                 "Very Conservative"),
                      ordered = TRUE),
    
    # Party ID
    party_id = factor(party_id,
                      levels = c("Democrat",
                                 "Lean Democrat",
                                 "Don't Lean/Independent/None",
                                 "Lean Republican",
                                 "Republican"),
                      ordered = TRUE)) |>
  tbl_summary(
    by = race,
    label = list(
      AGE ~ "Age",
      gender ~ "Gender",
      education ~ "Education",
      income ~ "Household Income",
      region ~ "Region",
      ideology ~ "Ideology",
      party_id ~ "Party Identification",
      limit_imm_recode ~ "US Should Limit Immigration",
      english_imm_recode ~ "Immigrants Should Learn English",
      amnesty_imm_recode ~ "Persecution Refugees Should Be Able to Come",
      law_imm_recode ~ "Immigrants Should Not Break the Law"
    ),
    statistic = list(
      AGE ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    digits = list(
      AGE ~ c(1, 1),
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1)
    ),
    missing = "no"
  ) |>
  add_overall() |>
  add_p() |>
  bold_labels() |>
  bold_p(t = 0.05) |>
  modify_caption("**Table 1. Sample Descriptive Statistics by Race/Ethnicity**")

print(amp_table)
```

# Modeling

## Creating Modeling Dataset

```{r}
amp_model <- amp_clean |>
  select(
    # Outcomes
    limit_imm_recode,
    english_imm_recode,
    amnesty_imm_recode,
    law_imm_recode,
    # Key predictors
    race,
    ideology,
    party_id,
    # Controls
    gender,
    education,
    income,
    AGE,
    region,
    conprot
  ) |>
  drop_na()  # drops any row missing ANY of these variables
```

## Setting Priors

```{r}
## PRIORS ##################
priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 3), class = Intercept),
  prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = b)
)
```

## Model 1 (Don't compile if models loaded already work)

```{r}
m1_ideo <- brms::brm(
  limit_imm_recode ~ race * ideology +
    gender + education + income + AGE + region,
  data = amp_model,
  family = cumulative("logit"),
  prior = priors,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1234
)

m1_party <- brms::brm(
  limit_imm_recode ~ race * party_id +
    gender + education + income + AGE + region,
  data = amp_model,
  family = cumulative("logit"),
  prior = priors,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1234
)

m1_both <- brms::brm(
  limit_imm_recode ~ race * ideology + race * party_id +
    gender + education + income + AGE + region,
  data = amp_model,
  family = cumulative("logit"),
  prior = priors,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1234
)

m1_additive <- brms::brm(
  limit_imm_recode ~ race + ideology + party_id +
    gender + education + income + AGE + region,
  data = amp_model,
  family = cumulative("logit"),
  prior = priors,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  chains = 4, cores = 4, seed = 1234
)

```

# LOO Comparisons

```{r}
# M1
m1_ideo     <- add_criterion(m1_ideo,     "loo")
m1_party    <- add_criterion(m1_party,    "loo")
m1_both     <- add_criterion(m1_both,     "loo")
m1_additive <- add_criterion(m1_additive, "loo")
loo_m1 <- loo_compare(m1_ideo, m1_party, m1_both, m1_additive)
print(loo_m1)

# M2
m2_ideo     <- add_criterion(m2_ideo,     "loo")
m2_party    <- add_criterion(m2_party,    "loo")
m2_both     <- add_criterion(m2_both,     "loo")
m2_additive <- add_criterion(m2_additive, "loo")
loo_m2 <- loo_compare(m2_ideo, m2_party, m2_both, m2_additive)
print(loo_m2)

# M3
m3_ideo     <- add_criterion(m3_ideo,     "loo")
m3_party    <- add_criterion(m3_party,    "loo")
m3_both     <- add_criterion(m3_both,     "loo")
m3_additive <- add_criterion(m3_additive, "loo")
loo_m3 <- loo_compare(m3_ideo, m3_party, m3_both, m3_additive)
print(loo_m3)

# M4
m4_ideo     <- add_criterion(m4_ideo,     "loo")
m4_party    <- add_criterion(m4_party,    "loo")
m4_both     <- add_criterion(m4_both,     "loo")
m4_additive <- add_criterion(m4_additive, "loo")
loo_m4 <- loo_compare(m4_ideo, m4_party, m4_both, m4_additive)
print(loo_m4)

```

## Figure 1. LOO-CV

```{r}

# M1
df_m1 <- as.data.frame(loo_m1)
df_m1$model <- sub("^m1_", "", rownames(df_m1))
df_m1$set <- "M1: Limit Immigration"

# M2
df_m2 <- as.data.frame(loo_m2)
df_m2$model <- sub("^m2_", "", rownames(df_m2))
df_m2$set <- "M2: Learn English"

# M3
df_m3 <- as.data.frame(loo_m3)
df_m3$model <- sub("^m3_", "", rownames(df_m3))
df_m3$set <- "M3: Refugees Fleeing Persecution"

# M4
df_m4 <- as.data.frame(loo_m4)
df_m4$model <- sub("^m4_", "", rownames(df_m4))
df_m4$set <- "M4: Do Not Break Law"

loo_all <- rbind(df_m1, df_m2, df_m3, df_m4)

# Check: should list exactly "additive" "both" "ideo" "party"
unique(loo_all$model)

# Readable labels; levels run bottom-to-top on the y-axis
loo_all$model <- factor(loo_all$model,
                        levels = c("ideo", "party", "additive", "both"),
                        labels = c("Ideology Only", "Party ID Only", "Additive", "Both"))

# Panel order top-to-bottom
loo_all$set <- factor(loo_all$set,
                      levels = c("M1: Limit Immigration", "M2: Learn English",
                                 "M3: Refugees Fleeing Persecution", "M4: Do Not Break Law"))

f1 <- ggplot(loo_all, aes(x = elpd_diff, y = model, color = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = elpd_diff - 2 * se_diff,
                    xmax = elpd_diff + 2 * se_diff),
                width = 0.15) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ set, ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Ideology Only" = "#E69F00",
                                "Party ID Only" = "#0072B2",
                                "Additive"      = "#009E73",
                                "Both"          = "grey20")) +
  labs(title = "Model Comparison: Ideology vs Party ID",
       subtitle = "ELPD difference relative to best model (±2 SE)",
       x = "ELPD Difference (lower = worse fit)",
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title.position = "plot")
```

### Saving the Plot

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = paste0("plots/", "f1", ".png"),
  plot = f1,
  width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300
)
```

# Tables and Plots

## Table 2. Ideology M1

```{r}
summary(m1_ideo)
```

## Figure 2. Ideology M1

```{r}

# 1. Collapsing response categories into two 

ideology_levels <- c("Very Liberal", "Somewhat Liberal", "Moderate",
                     "Somewhat Conservative", "Very Conservative")
x_labels_ideo   <- c("Very\nLiberal", "Somewhat\nLiberal", "Moderate",
                     "Somewhat\nConservative", "Very\nConservative")

sum_m1_ideo <- aap_m1_ideo |> 
  mutate(
    response_collapsed = case_when(
      response %in% c("Strongly agree", "Somewhat agree")       ~ "Agree",
      response %in% c("Strongly disagree", "Somewhat disagree")       ~ "Disagree"
    )
  ) |> 
  filter(response_collapsed == "Agree") |>
  group_by(race, political_position, .draw, response_collapsed) |> 
  summarise(.epred = sum(.epred), .groups = "drop") |> 
  group_by(race, political_position, response_collapsed) |> 
  summarise(
    mean = mean(.epred),
    lower = quantile(.epred, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(.epred, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
    mutate(political_position = factor(political_position,
                                     levels = ideology_levels,
                                     labels = x_labels_ideo))


# 2. Plotting


f2 <- ggplot(sum_m1_ideo, 
       aes(x = political_position, y = mean,
         color = race, 
         group = race)) +
         geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = race),
              alpha = 0.10, color = NA) +
           geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
           scale_color_manual(values = c("White"    = "#999999",
                                "AAPI"     = "#E69F00",
                                "Black"    = "#0072B2",
                                "Hispanic" = "#009E73"),
                     name = "Race") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("White"    = "#999999",
                               "AAPI"     = "#E69F00",
                               "Black"    = "#0072B2",
                               "Hispanic" = "#009E73"),
                    name = "Race") +
           scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) +
           labs(title = "M1: Limit Immigration \u2014 Ideology",
                x = NULL,
                y = "Predicted Probability of Agreeing") +
           theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        plot.title       = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"))

print(f2)

# 3. Save Plots

ggsave(
  filename = paste0("plots/", "f2", ".png"),
  plot = f2,
  width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

```
